title: Native run of loader-diag-xnu-hb-md1 (decision 0038), the NAT-102 diagnostic image whose /etc/rc launches NAT-101's hb before /sbin/launchd.darwin on an idle host: does hb start and print markers and ps -A / ps -Ao pid,ppid,stat,comm lists to /dev/console after launchd and logd start (rows H0-H5), and which self-starting Apple daemons are alive when console noise resumes?
acceptance: One run under decision 0038 (written before launch), RECOVERY (/dev/block/sda18) only, restored from the pinned stock recovery.img (96620b8b...babf67) via NAT-013 with full readback verification; Android and user data verified via check_android.py and restore_stock.py assess afterwards; no retry; host 1-min load < 6.0 and zero concurrent heavy builds/tests recorded at launch.

Post-run analysis runs only after collector and watcher processes have exited, using unchanged analyze_nat087.py (chain rows), analyze_nat097.py (Stage A A1-A8), and analyze_nat102.py (heartbeat ladder H0-H5 over kl_reader2).
Any row other than H5 is recorded as the finding with its numbers in evidence.json and does not complete the task.
steps: Open native permit citing decision 0038 and add/claim NAT-103
Preflight, single execution, stock RECOVERY restore, and Android verification
Close native permit, run pre-registered analysers, and record evidence
